A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Curriculum DPO work. All 19 pages, including equations, tables, figures and appendices, support reliable comparison; the appendix pages are unchanged.

before.justification: v3 reports original text-to-image experiments, ablations and a nine-evaluator human study in Section 4 and Appendices 9–13.

after.justification: v5 retains the original benchmark results, ablations and human evaluation study, including the supplementary experiments.

M1.justification: The Consistency-DPO objective and curriculum procedure are retained. Algorithm 1 removes a stray loser superscript from the second sample in its reward comparison; this corrects notation without changing the procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same animal-prompt dataset D1, DrawBench D2 and Pick-a-Pic D3, covering text alignment, aesthetics and human preference. No evaluation scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain the pretrained LCM/SD baselines, DDPO and DPO. The component ablations and naive Consistency-DPO comparison in Figure 4 are also unchanged.

E3.justification: Dataset sizes, metrics, model checkpoints, generation settings, 10,000-iteration training budget and human-study procedures remain identical, including appendix settings.

E4.justification: The hyperparameter and component ablations, alternative reward-model comparison, qualitative cases and low-sample analysis are retained. Figure 3's caption clarification adds no analysis.

E5.justification: Both versions retain three-run averages and ± reporting in Tables 1 and 3, the same significance statements, and the inter-rater agreement reporting in Appendix 12.

E6.justification: Tables 1–6 and the plotted and qualitative results retain the same values and findings. Table 1 changes the LCM/DDPO/D2 human-preference uncertainty from '0,0019' to '0.0019', a decimal-separator correction with no numerical change.

T1.justification: Equations 1–21 and the mathematical reasoning are unchanged. Algorithm 1's superscript correction and added reference to Equation 6 introduce no new definition, assumption or derivation.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about Curriculum DPO, the consistency-model adaptation, benchmark superiority and sample efficiency.

C2.justification: Section 3.3 adds 'style, realism, aesthetics' as examples of existing reward factors, without changing its coarse-to-fine explanation. Result interpretations, scalability conclusions and stated limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Implementation settings, hyperparameters, hardware, training time, data-generation instructions and code-access information are retained. The added equation cross-reference supplies no new implementation detail.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, all 79 references and the positioning relative to earlier DPO and curriculum-learning methods are unchanged.

P1.justification: v5 adds illustrative reward-factor examples in Section 3.3 and an Equation 6 cross-reference in Algorithm 1, corrects notation and decimal punctuation, and updates the version stamp. These are localized editorial refinements.

P2.justification: Figure 3's caption now identifies the studied curves as blue. The plots themselves, other figures, table structures and document organization remain unchanged, with only localized text reflow.

improvement.justification: v5 modestly improves readability by identifying Figure 3's blue curves, correcting inconsistent notation in Algorithm 1 and linking its loss to Equation 6. These provide limited clarity gains; the scientific methods, evidence and appendix material remain unchanged.
